definition: A tile is relevant CONUS GIS coverage when at least one 0.05-degree habitat sample-cell center lies inside a U.S. state (cb_2023_us_state_500k, raw) and on terrestrial land (Annual NLCD 2023 land cover present and not class 11 open water).

cross_check.role: Independent full-resolution legal-boundary cross-check of the classification. It agreed on every reclassified tile (zero U.S. land cells for all 23 exclusions, real land cells for all 5 inclusions and every fallback/coastal canary). Not used at runtime.

land_cover.product: Annual NLCD Land Cover, CONUS, 2023, Collection 1 Version 2
land_cover.role: Terrestrial mask: a sample cell is land when its NLCD class is present and not 11 (open water).

state_boundary.caveat: Cartographic boundary generalized to 1:500,000; materially finer than the legacy 1:20,000,000 roster geometry and its ~2 km simplification. Shoreline-clipped, so a point inside the polygon is jurisdictional; the NLCD non-water test supplies the terrestrial requirement.
state_boundary.crs: NAD83 (EPSG:4269); reprojected to EPSG:4326 for point tests
